set.body:
Scope
Make theorem assumptions and achieved optimization claims evidence-bearing.

Acceptance criteria
- Typed witnesses cover proper closed convexity, smoothness constants, strong convexity, PSD, coercivity on nullspaces, certified norm bounds, exact proximal/projector laws, and controlled inexactness.
- Achieved guarantees distinguish ExactGlobal, EpsilonGlobal, bounded-distance uniqueness, Stationary, CoordinatewiseStationary, FeasibleOnly, and Unresolved.
- A low-level Converged status cannot manufacture a semantic optimum claim.
- Certificates bind program/data/mask/operator/parameter identities and final semantic residuals or gaps.
- Compiler admission fails when a required witness is absent or inconsistent.
- Analytic and negative law tests exercise every guarantee transition on JVM and JS.
set.title: Multivar math 1: proof-bearing assumptions and achieved guarantee ADTs
